notes: The ROS builder feels like the Sheet. Drag a column's edge to resize it (double-click to fit; widths kept on the Mac), with #, Cue #, Type and Description frozen on the left. Enter goes down a row like the Sheet (⌘Enter inserts a cue), ← → move between cells, long text wraps (Shift+Enter for a new line). Undo everything: ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z for typing, deleted rows and removed departments, plus an Undo button after a delete. Paste from the Sheet: copy rows in the Sheet (or Excel) and paste them in as new rows, departments matched by name; ⌘C copies picked rows back out for the Sheet. Work on several…
